g.text: Dispatch: FileNode.accept(v) calls v.visit(file); DirectoryNode.accept(v) calls v.visit(directory).
TreeWalker forwards each visit to its selected operation. Operation visitors do not traverse children.
Dashed + hollow triangle: realizes interface. Solid + hollow triangle: inherits class.
Solid open arrows: association. Dashed open arrow: dependency. Fields also show references.
